'''Manak leaves''' were a type of flavorful leaf that was harvested from the [[manak]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="PhantomDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> individuals on Tatooine began harvesting the leaves and using them to wrap and roast [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]], an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] also native to Tatooine.<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Manak leaves were first mentioned mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', published by [[Chronicle Books]] and written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Bob Carrau]].<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
